name: Xod
description: A healer who gives Yawgmoth the idea of a metal serum and later reappears as a Phyrexian warrior.

description_citations.text: "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth's war caravel survives the Alliance's counterattack; a Phyrexian warrior carries him back and he recognizes Xod.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth realizes it is Xod, the healer who gave him the inspiration for the serum so many years before.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth quells Gix's rebellion with free serum and is made a member of the Halcyon council.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth was made a member of the council of Halcyon

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Rise to Power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xod helps Yawgmoth ascend; he annihilates the dwarven and human armies with stonechargers.
timeline.quote: He used stonechargers to annihilate both the dwarven and the human army of the desert just outside Halcyon

citation.text: "Battle of Halcyon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: Turned into a wall-walking Phyrexian who helped Yawgmoth ascend.
